text:
alex: Quick dump from tonight's canary — small cohort hit p95 drift when draining hosts holding sticky sessions. Noticed lots of KV misses on targets.
alex: Impact ~3% of requests, p95 ~1.7x for a ~8m window.
maya: timeline? was it a deploy + scale?
alex: yeah autoscale + rolling deploy. affinity kept routing some messages to draining nodes while new hosts were cold.
reza: idea: hybrid prefetch + staged-weight approach. Instead of routing probes that cost full request cycles, emit async prefetches for likely prefixes, then route a tiny fraction once prefetch_hit_rate looks healthy.
nina: so two-phase: prefetch-only, then probe-route, then ramp. Makes sense. What signals do we use to decide transitions?
maya: keep it small: prefetch_hit_rate, target_p95_ratio (target / source), and probe_success_rate. Local decision per-cohort; central controller only for overrides.
reza: config sketch (proto stores strings):
```json
{"strategy":"hybrid-prefetch-staged","prefetch_start_pct":"1","prefetch_max_pct":"10","probe_start_pct":"1","probe_max_pct":"8","prefetch_window_s":"45","p95_ratio_thresh":"1.5","prefetch_hit_thresh":"0.7","probe_success_thresh":"0.85"}
```
alex: ops visibility: Console needs per-cohort phase, prefetch_pct, prefetch_hit, probe_pct, p95_ratio, and last-fallback-reason. Also an alert for probe_success < 0.7 over 5m. ops-bot: will post handoff/fallback events to rollout stream.
maya: session handling: keep sticky for active sessions initially (sticky-hold). For VIP tenants we can expose an opt-in prefix-migration API later.
reza: testing: unit transition tests + canary with synthetic long-session traffic + chaos test that injects cold-KV on targets. I'll run a small simulator to tune thresholds.
nina: runbook: on fallback -> pause rollout, check prefetch_hit trend, increase prefetch_pct, or rollback if sustained p95 delta. Ping eng-oncall for the first 48h.
alex: want a small UX: let oncall manually trigger a temporary prefetch-boost from Console for a cohort.
maya: agree. Also tenant-priority lanes so big customers get higher prefetch allocation.
reza: i'll draft RFC today with proto samples, state machine diagram, and sim results. nina: I'll add dashboards and alerts. alex: thanks all — will schedule a careful canary and loop in eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
